tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Otech 2U Rack Mount PC Casing – Reliable Server Chassis for Data Centers & IT Solutions


The Otech 2U Rack Mount PC Casing is a high-performance and durable server enclosure designed to fit standard 19-inch racks. Built with heavy-duty steel, this chassis ensures long-lasting reliability while maintaining efficient airflow and cooling for stable system performance. With its compact 2U form factor, it is the perfect choice for data centers, corporate IT setups, and networking solutions.


Key Specifications:

  • Model: Otech 2U Rack Mount PC Casing
  • Form Factor: 2U (Rackmount)
  • Rack Compatibility: Standard 19-inch server racks
  • Material: Heavy-duty SECC steel structure
  • Drive Bays: Supports multiple 3.5"/2.5" HDD/SSD
  • Cooling System: Pre-installed cooling fans with additional fan support for improved airflow
  • Front Panel I/O: USB 2.0/USB 3.0, Power & Reset Switch
  • Expansion Slots: PCI/PCIe slot support (depending on motherboard)
  • Motherboard Support: Micro-ATX (M-ATX), Mini-ITX
  • Application: Server, storage system, networking, and industrial PC use
